news.title: STAT+: BlackRock to buy majority stake in Humana’s CenterWell clinics for $2.8 billion
news.summary: Humana is swapping out private equity sponsors for its CenterWell Senior Primary Care clinics. Good bye, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe. Hello, BlackRock.

news.title: Helen Branswell, whose reporting on infectious diseases and public health drew acclaim, dies at 69
news.summary: Helen Branswell, STAT's infectious disease reporter who earned the respect of experts and public health officials with her accessible, prescient dispatches, has died at age 69.

news.title: STAT+: Many patient, consumer reps on FDA advisory panels have ties to groups funded by pharma, analysis finds
news.summary: Nearly 40% of FDA advisory committee meetings over a 20-year period included either a patient or consumer rep with active ties to an advocacy group funded by pharma companies.

news.title: STAT+: Animosity in North Carolina, and MA shooting stars
news.summary: In this edition of Health Care Inc., we examine the controversy around the health plan covering North Carolina's public workers and retirees, and more.

news.title: STAT+: Doctors are giving generously to doctors running for office
news.summary: Doctors have a lot on the line in the next couple years, and they are donating big to doctors running for political office.

news.title: STAT+: FTC demands Martin Shkreli divest his pharma stocks
news.summary: The FTC asked a federal court to hold Martin Shkreli in contempt for violating a court order banning him from working in the pharmaceutical industry

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about concerns over a rare disease drug, pharma payments to docs, and more
news.summary: Patient advocates and some experts are expressing growing alarm over the perceived risks of a Neurocrine Biosciences rare disease drug

news.title: STAT+: Takeaways from an evaluation of Google’s diagnostic chatbot, AMIE
news.summary: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: A look at a study recently published in The Lancet about Google's diagnostic chatbot, AMIE.

news.title: How many ways can the Trump administration clamp down on international researchers?
news.summary: In the span of two days last week, the Trump administration issued two sweeping announcements meant to crack down on international students and scholars, who make up a sizable portion…

news.title: Opinion: Lethal injection will never be the same after Christa Pike’s botched execution
news.summary: “The legal and medical issues in the Christa Pike case are on a collision course,” writes bioethicist M. Sara Rosenthal.

news.title: STAT+: Concerns grow on safety issues tied to Neurocrine Biosciences rare disease drug
news.summary: Patient advocates and some experts are expressing growing alarm over the perceived risks of a rare disease drug sold by Neurocrine Biosciences.

news.title: Opinion: STAT+: The epidemic of learned helplessness in physicians
news.summary: “Hordes of brilliant, graduate-degree-holding professionals in their 40s, 50s, and beyond act helpless at work,” writes STAT columnist Frances Mei Hardin.

news.title: Judge rejects NC State Health Plan's request to block Atrium Health's affordability program
news.summary: The state's treasurer has said the large health system's Affordability Protection Program, a response to being left out of a preferred provider program, would bankrupt the public health plan.

news.title: VBC accelerator Diverge merges with Medical Home Network to support PCPs, FQHCs
news.summary: Together, the organizations hope to reach broader swaths of patients in value-based arrangements. MHN will continue operating under the Diverge platform, mobilizing more community-based teams, though the brands will remain distinct

news.title: Measles update: US passes 4,000 cases, Pennsylvania reports sixth death
news.summary: Experts have pointed to sagging vaccination rates and friction between federal health leadership and the broader public health community as contributors to this year’s outbreaks of the vaccine-preventable disease.

news.title: CVS, DOJ reach $315M settlement in opioid prescription case
news.summary: CVS Health has reached a $315 million settlement with the Department of Justice that resolves allegations the pharmacy giant knowingly filled unlawful opioid prescriptions.

news.title: UnitedHealth Group execs detail continued improvements at Optum Health
news.summary: Another round of healthcare industry earnings reports kicked off Tuesday morning, with UnitedHealth Group reporting $4.1 billion in profit for the third quarter.

news.title: UNMC, Nebraska Medicine teaching hospital project upgrades to $2.75B planned investment
news.summary: The project’s new scope reflects an approximate $500 million increase from its initial estimate.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Joint Commission names COO; Beth Israel Lahey unveils next CEO
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Samaritan Health Services, MultiCare Health System merger to close Nov. 1
news.summary: The affiliation approved by the nonprofits' boards will create an 18-hospital system with more than $7.5 billion in revenue—and give MultiCare an acute-care foothold in Oregon.

news.title: Humana, BlackRock strike $2.8B deal to manage CenterWell clinics
news.summary: Humana will enter a joint venture with investment firm BlackRock to manage and operate its CenterWell primary care clinics for older adults, swapping out its current partner Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe.

news.title: Brigham and Women's nurses postpone open-ended strike
news.summary: With contract talks stalled since August, unionized Mass General Brigham employees had voted 93% in favor of a 4,000-nurse demonstration that could've become the largest in Massachusetts history.

news.title: Suki secures $90M in series E funding to accelerate growth, expand AI capabilities
news.summary: The funding announcement comes less than a week after the company launched its newest AI capability.

news.title: Johns Hopkins Medicine taps OpenEvidence to bring AI into medical education, clinical care
news.summary: Johns Hopkins Medicine is teaming up with OpenEvidence to advance the use of artificial intelligence in medical education and clinical care.

news.title: Insulet’s Omnipod Discover platform sees full market release in US
news.summary: Insulet Corporation has announced the U.S. full market release of Omnipod Discover, a web-based data platform designed for Omnipod 5.

news.title: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer vaccine fails phase 3 test, significantly denting analysts’ confidence
news.summary: A phase 2/3 clinical trial of BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 has missed one of its dual primary endpoints. But with immature overall survival data offering a path to redemption, the German biotech is continuing to track patients in the metastatic head and neck cancer study.

news.title: Biotech builder Paragon imports Apogee's top brass after AbbVie buyout
news.summary: It’s been a busy morning for Paragon Labs. In addition to bringing over much of the leadership team from AbbVie-acquired Apogee Therapeutics, Paragon has overseen a reverse merger to take its hypertension-focused spinout Velaris Therapeutics public.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Soufflé cooks up $135M; Matchpoint makes $150M
news.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

news.title: Roche inks $1.2B deal with China's Rona to enter emerging ALK7 obesity race
news.summary: Roche has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to license Rona Therapeutics’ ALK7 drug candidate, joining Alnylam, Arrowhead, GSK and Novo Nordisk in an emerging obesity niche.

news.title: Pfizer pens $500M Enodia pact to join Lilly in emerging protein degrader field
news.summary: Pfizer has followed Eli Lilly into the Sec61 space, inking a $500 million deal with Enodia Therapeutics days after its Big Pharma peer formed an $870 million pact with Gate Bioscience.

news.title: Nurix drops one BTK degrader as momentum builds behind Roche-partnered option
news.summary: Nurix’s BTK degrader zelebrudomide may have survived a clinical hold in recent years, but that hasn’t stopped the California biotech from dropping the cancer drug.

news.title: Roche sets sights on FDA approval decision of July 2027 with updated eye drug data
news.summary: One year on from a mixed phase 3 readout, Roche has shared updated data from eye disease trials that could support FDA approval by July.

news.title: Tortugas’ schizophrenia drug proves worth in phase 2 Hansoh trial in China
news.summary: Tortugas Neuroscience’s schizophrenia drug from Hansoh Pharma has proven its worth in a phase 2b study, validating the fledgling biotech’s neurology strategy.

news.title: BMS doubles up with pivotal wins in lung disease, solid tumor that offer hope for post-patent cliff growth
news.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has reported phase 3 wins in a lung disease and a solid tumor, taking two steps on its path toward post-patent cliff growth.

news.title: iRegene Therapeutics’s NouvSight001 Cleared for Clinical Trials in the U.S. and China for Retinitis Pigmentosa
news.summary: Following its Parkinson’s disease program, iRegene advances another off-the-shelf cell therapy into clinical development in the U.S. and China.

news.title: Merck’s deeper dive into efficacy, safety of $1.3B eye disease drug raises fears of ‘limited’ potential
news.summary: Merck & Co. has poured out its Brunello data, revealing a mix of undifferentiated efficacy and concerning safety that led analysts to predict “limited competitive potential” in diabetic macular edema. The company paid $1.3 billion upfront in 2024 to buy the asset and the rest of Eyebiotech.

news.title: 清创、敷料、负压引流，慢创治疗多年就这三板斧：基甲医疗想做 ' 国内首款创面愈合专用激光平台 '
news.summary: 基甲医疗推激光慢创治疗项目，正进行新一轮融资

papers.title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
papers.summary: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion,

papers.title: X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning
papers.summary: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. papers.title: Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
papers.summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (Rubric-RL) trains language models where no verifier exists. A judge checks each criterion of a rubric, and the verdicts are aggregated into a reward, most often by a weighted sum. We show that this additive aggregation is the weak point. Under a sum, criteria compensate for one another: a policy that misses the one decision that matters can buy the points back with advice nobody asked for.
